I did not re-run the test reversions. I read each new test against its fix, and each asserts behavior the base lacks. I rely on the writer's account that each failed when its fix was reverted.

Built-in `/code-review`:
With `HEAD~1...HEAD` it read the main checkout and returned unrelated design-core findings, all rejected as out of range.
With `c001260b...a38a5eea` it returned 7 findings, classified below.

Non-blocking findings:
1. /home/user/holyagent-0.3.1-cap/packages/runtime/src/setup/capabilities.ts:92-94 — the symlink check on the config write runs only when `!dryRun`. The lock check runs on dry runs, and the `.pi` writes check symlinks on dry runs too (`pi-settings.ts:256`). A dry run against a symlinked `.holyagent/config.json` reports "would turn on" and succeeds, and the real run then fails. Moving the `refuseLinks` call above the `if` fixes it. Optional.
2. /home/user/holyagent-0.3.1-cap/docs/usage.md:182 and /home/user/holyagent-0.3.1-cap/packages/runtime/src/setup/tui/theme.ts:74 — both still say or test "CI other than false". `inCi` now treats `0`, `no` and `off` as unset, so `CI=0` starts the setup screen but strips its colour. The writer already noted both as outside its paths. Optional; `theme.ts` could reuse `inCi`.
3. /home/user/holyagent-0.3.1-cap/packages/runtime/src/setup/steps.ts:219-228 and `capabilities.ts` — a locked-on refusal fails the whole capability step, so a valid choice in the same run is not saved. The skip line does not say which capability was the problem. The non-interactive `setup()` path re-loads the config in several steps and reads the user config again in `refuseLockedOn`; `T3SettingsOptions.config` is used only by the interactive path. Optional, and a performance note only.
4. /home/user/holyagent-0.3.1-cap/packages/runtime/src/setup/capabilities.ts:66 — the JSDoc `{@link refuseLinks}` is split across two lines. Cosmetic.

The six fixes:
**User lock:** `userLocksOff` reuses `FINAL_OFF`. The refusal covers `project` and `local` scope, only for a turn-on, and a turn-off or user scope still works. The test covers refusal, nothing installed, nothing written, and the allowed cases.
**Failed write stops the Pi steps:** `piSteps` is false when any capability line starts with `! `, and a skip line is printed. The Claude settings merge and ctx7 still run, as the writer said.
**CI truthy:** `inCi` is shared by `detectForm` and `tuiFallbackReason`. Tests cover both with a value matrix.
**One load and probe per interactive run:** the config and `piUsed` are passed into `t3Offer` and the review preview. `t3Offer` only runs at user scope, so the scope of the config is the same as before. The test asserts one probe and that the review uses the loaded config.
**`refuseLinks` on the config write:** the function body moved to `scope.ts` unchanged. The `.pi` call sites at `pi-settings.ts:256`, `376` and `507` behave as before, and type-check and tests pass. The new test covers a symlinked file and a symlinked folder.
**No fallback line without T3 work:** `preview === undefined ? line : fallback(reason)`. The tests cover no terminal, `--no-tui` and a choice flag.

No other behavior changed. The JSDoc and docs edits are consistent with the code.
